_about: Past terms’ published group crosstabs of national primary voting intention, in data/demographics.json’s wave format, read by gen-data §7gm (the vote-by-group model, group-span.mjs): the final pre-election tables of the 2013–2025 elections (data/demographics-20xx-election.json), Newspoll’s quarterly breakdowns 2004–2016 (Wayback copies of newspoll.com.au and The Australian’s PDFs), and the 2022–25 term’s Resolve, Essential, YouGov, Newspoll, RedBridge, Freshwater and DemosAU tables (checked against the houses’ own releases; feed errors corrected). Shares are decided voters’, a printed undecided share set aside (Essential’s too, since 2026-11-23: its undecided had been folded into others). Assembled 2026-11-23; sources and checks in .build/analysis/primary-bayes/history/groups-2004-2022 and groups-2022-2025 (not committed).

waves.publication: 7 September 2013 (Newspoll election-eve table card, published election morning)
waves.pool: final Newspoll of the 2013 campaign, survey conducted 3–5 September 2013, telephone, 2,511 interviews among voters (maximum sampling error ±2 points)

waves.publication: ~30 June 2016 (The Australian, Newspoll 'web_news_fed_elect' tables; The Australian's breakdown story relayed by Poll Bludger 28 June 2016)
waves.pool: Newspoll reanalysis of surveys conducted in June 2016, 5,385 interviews (the final-pool Newspoll demographic tables of the 2016 campaign)

waves.publication: 26 March 2019 (The Australian 'Federal election graphic', Newspoll quarterly demographic tables)
waves.pool: Newspoll quarterly demographic reanalysis, surveys conducted between 24 January and 10 March 2019, 6,393 interviews

waves.publication: 14 May 2019 (The Australian state-breakdown piece; relayed by Poll Bludger same day)
waves.pool: Newspoll state breakdowns 'aggregated from the results of its last five polls going back to the start of April' (The Australian's pre-election pooled table)

waves.publication: 2022-03-25 (The Australian; relayed by Poll Bludger same day)
waves.pool: Newspoll quarterly breakdowns Jan–Mar 2022 ('three months’ combined polling'); the final breakdowns piece Newspoll published before the 21 May 2022 election

waves.publication: 2022-05-20 (The Australian 'Newspoll: Labor lead over Coalition narrows'; relayed by Poll Bludger same day)
waves.pool: final Newspoll of the 2022 campaign, 'conducted Friday to Thursday from a larger than usual sample of 2188' = Fri 13 – Thu 19 May 2022 — final-week development: the AMP-accessed The Australian story prints 'independents and other minor parties… nine per cent', so Others=9 completes the printed table (36/35/12/5/3/9 sums 100)
